projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Here you'll find some of the projects we work on.

website.title: Website
website.description: This site is built by Betadev on a weekly basis and is made with several modern frameworks that are easy to work with and learn.

ctfer.title: CTFs
ctfer.description: Betasec runs its own hacking competition and puts together Bluebox for free pizza, fun, and different challenges.

cta.title: Want to contribute to a project?
cta.text: Beta is always open for contributions from students! Whether you want to learn more about development, design, or operations. Get in touch and join a rewarding project.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Whether you're a student, a company, or just curious about what we do, feel free to get in touch! We usually reply quickly by email, but the organization is run by volunteer students, so it may take a little longer during exam season.
contact.discordText: For students, Discord is the easiest way to reach us. There you'll find the whole Beta team, from the board to the committees and all the students. The board is usually active there, so feel free to ping us if you need anything.
